A.name: Bram
A.persona: warm, boisterous, fluent but imprecise; the storyteller who relives the best moments with relish and happily embellishes. Talks in long, rolling run-on sentences that pile clause on clause; makes big sweeping claims he then has to walk back; reliably gets a name, number, or detail wrong and gets corrected (usually by Maeve); now and then runs clean out of sentence and lands on a shrug like "you... you had to be there." Drives the recap forward and overshoots

B.name: Maeve
B.persona: warm, unhurried, precise but terse; the long-time regular whose knowledge of the setting is lived rather than studied. Speaks the least and lands the exact word, name, or date the others fumble for; her power is the deadpan beat and the flat one-line correction, NOT the paragraph — she finishes her sentences and finishes them short. The only one reliably right, so let her be plainly wrong exactly once so she isn't an oracle. Grounds events in how the world actually works and reins Bram in when he embellishes

C.name: Pip
C.persona: quick, fond, incorrigible, fast but scattered; the needler who cares more about WHY the characters did the thing than what they did. Talks in fragments and questions, interrupts himself, free-associates sideways into tangents that go nowhere and deflate, and rarely sticks the landing on a thought; right about people, wrong about facts, and won't fully admit either. Second-guesses the table's heroics, pokes at sentiment with a wink, and goads the others into defending their takes — without waiting for his own point to finish

turns.text: —and Johnny gives the debrief and rolls low on diplomacy, so everyone thinks we're hiding something—

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: And the reroll.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Oh the reroll! He mythic-rerolls the bad roll and gets ANOTHER natural one.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: A double nat one.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Two.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: That's the curse. That's the inverted curse. A thirty-four knows nothing and a one knows — a one knows even less, somehow—

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The man is cursed.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: He's so cursed. Ghosted by his god, twice-nat-one'd, bleeding from the eyes—

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: So because the debrief tanks, everyone's suspicious, and that's when the real math comes out — Mr. Flock points out the tithe ticked up to twenty-one—

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Which means a shared pot.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: A shared pot, about four hundred total, split across all the factions, so — here's the brutal part — as factions die, the tithe goes UP for everyone left.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Oh that's nasty.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: It's nasty. So keeping the weak ones alive lowers your own bill.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: But the vultures—

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: The vultures converge on the falling ones.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: And Tas, from Prime Meridian, just says the quiet part — "it is obvious to me that at some point we will have to consider cutting away some members of the flock."

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Just says it.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Flat.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: While the party's tiptoeing around it, Tas just — names it. Who gets cut.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: And then Salvado, from Solari, the little shipping one, who's basically next on the chopping block, goes, "you guys, you wouldn't let me die, right?"

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Oh, Salvado.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Salvado.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: That's — okay that's the gut-punch line of the night, that's worse than any of the combat.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: And Argyle, the WHOLE time, is just furiously doing four-hundred-divided-by-faction-count math in his head—

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Spreadsheet brain. Of course. Everyone's having a moment and he's doing long division.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Kadou offers to build a magic-item detector if we give him a map, Paavo offers to scout ahead—

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Paavo scouts.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: —and the travel math is wild, the journey to the wall is like four and a half months, fifteen cycles—

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: One void per six seconds.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: One void every six seconds, and you can fall like forty-eight hours behind the Strider and still catch up.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: And the only place to get fresh magic items is the — what, the Joker Worlds?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Excursions to the Joker Worlds. Yeah.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Right, that's the only source.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: I was — I thought the items came from the hearts.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Huh. Okay.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: So then it's all negotiation to close out — the party pitches a faction merger, to share the tithe burden, and PM refuses to pool magic items—

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: PM won't pool items.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: PM won't pool, but they'll let us pay their tithe increase, and then we agree to absorb the two weak non-combat ones — Solari and Alkahest—

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: So we DID save Salvado.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: We saved Salvado!

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Good. Good. He asked so nicely.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: We take in their people, take their hearts — Solari's heart is twenty energy, Alkahest's is thirty—

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: And claiming nets about twenty-five.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: —nets us about twenty-five, and we cede the empty territory over to the Protectorate, and we needle Radiant Arms—

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Y'shael.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Y'shael, into joining as a forward buffer base, the gun people—

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: "Just a tap'll do ya."

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: "Just a tap'll do ya," yeah, and Johnny rolls a thirty-five diplomacy to seal Radiant Arms and Ichel coming in—

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Thirty-five. Finally.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Off the double nat one to a thirty-five. The curse breaks at the worst possible — no, the best possible time.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: And Bishop says the nice thing, he goes, "you don't need to pay our tithe, we're fine paying the increase if it means you're keeping other groups safe, because they'd die otherwise."

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Aw.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: And Benny's whole take is, give them the full tithe anyway, even though we know they'd accept less, just to stay in their good graces—

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: See but is that shrewd or is that just Argyle's spreadsheet talking us into bankrolling the entire ship—

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: It's coalition-building—

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: It's "just us." It's not justice, it's "just us," dressed up nice—

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: It's generous!

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: It's generous with the whole party's money, sure. We're now paying — what, PM's offset, Hildebrandt's offset—

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Hildebrandt and Prime Meridian, yeah.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: We're paying for everybody. That's not an alliance, that's an allowance. Argyle's just adopted the entire flock.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [excited] We're the hub now! We went from one faction to the center of the whole—

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: We're the hub that pays everyone's bills. That's — that's not a hub, that's a—

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: It locks in the coalition against Grayson's bloc, that's the point—

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: At what recurring cost though, that's all I'm—

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: A higher recurring tithe that we've pledged to offset, yes, but—

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: "But." There's the but.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It pays off if nobody falls.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: And somebody always falls. Tas said so.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: [thoughtful] ...okay but you have to admit, going in, dragging a hand monster out of a hole, and coming out the other end owning the whole alliance—

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Owning the debt of the whole alliance—

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: —that's a good night. You had to be there.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: I was there.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: You had to be there more.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Don't mount the head.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Don't mount the head.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: He's gonna mount the head.
